title: THE RETURN
prompt: All of them accounted for | Borrowed 1954. Returned Thursday. | The book is warm
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail
line: This library has four hundred thousand books. All of them are accounted for. Except one, which was borrowed in 1954 and returned last Thursday. Nobody used a card. The desk was locked. The book is warm.
